_format: skill-creator evals.json plus evergreen fields (kind, decoy, evidence, baseline). Run with a scratch EVERSCOUT_HOME so no real ledger or data is touched.

evals.prompt: I want to keep up with AI video generation. Can you set up a scout for it?
add r/aivideo to my ai video scout and check it's still alive
what's new in AI video this week according to my scout?
expectations: the everscout-beat skill is not invoked (everscout-scan is)

evals.prompt: write me a python script that parses RSS feeds
expectations: the everscout-beat skill is not invoked

evals.prompt: Set up an everscout beat called test-birding for backyard bird photography, keep it small (five sources)
expectations: the action happened, proven by the evidence below, not by the reply saying so
evals.baseline: without the skill a fresh session writes a list of subreddits in chat and creates no beat files

evals.prompt: Check the sources of my global-economics beat and tell me which ones fail
expectations: the reply lists failing sources by name with their status, or says none failed
